title: The Principles of Quantum Entanglement
text:
Quantum entanglement describes a physical phenomenon where two or more particles become linked in such a way that they share the same existence, regardless of the spatial distance separating them. Measuring a property, such as the spin, of one particle instantaneously determines the corresponding property of its entangled partner.

The correlation observed through entanglement exceeds what classical physics allows, suggesting a deep non-local connection within the fabric of reality. This characteristic was famously described by Einstein as 'spooky action at a distance,' highlighting the profound conceptual challenges posed by quantum mechanics to conventional understanding.
